item.title: Ask HN: What's wrong with my prompting for Claude 5?
item.summary: Is anybody able to get the Claude series 5 models to do what you ask them to do? I fed Claude a Kimi K3 conversation and asked it to refine it for me (see my prompt below): ``` ... original context including reference to the Kimi conversation ... Kimi's response is essentially "nearly there" but seems to be "missing a few intellectual tweaks". This is an experiment to see if you can do better than Kimi given the pre-existing information that has already been pre-searched for your benefit. your task is as follows: Accept the premise where observing other humans in real-time is or can be favorable to elderly MCI or dementia patients. Do the following: - tie any logical links together than kimi has missed - highlight false equivalencies Please use ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (STE) do not make up compound words or compound nouns. ``` Claude just started attacking the entire premise for no reason and going nowhere turn after turn. It also ignored my request for ASD-STE100 english and manufactured a few compound nouns, and outright ignored my instruction to refine the argument or accept the premise (it just keeps spending all the effort on tearing down the kimi argument) I'm
